- Pack E was authored via a different pipeline producing all-or-nothing CL assignments
- 5 of 6 Pack E sections have genuine, diverse CL assignments — but Section C has DL-021 (all distractor ExplanationWrong absent)
- Boundary review in S720 proved automated classifiers have 85.7% false-positive rate at Remember/Understand boundary

## 6. Critical Constraints

1. **Metadata-only scope.** S721 is a CL/DS/Diff metadata recalibration session. No stem, choice, answer-key, explanation, or question_state changes.
2. **Boundary review mandatory.** No CL change at Remember/Understand or Understand/Apply boundaries without independent human review (per S720 Agent C finding — 85.7% automated false-positive rate).
3. **DCS v1.1 is the authoritative standard.** All CL assignments must reference DCS v1.1 boundary decision trees and forbidden trigger catalog.
4. **Backup protocol mandatory.** Backup pack_e_corrected.js before any write.
5. **Batch cap: ≤30 items per governance-guard Rule 5.**
6. **0 DL-008 or DL-026 regressions.** Pre-write and post-write scans required.
7. **REVISION_HISTORY.md entry contemporaneous** — write during session, not after.
